definitions.explanation: The act of drawing or pulling something or someone inward, or attracting people into a place, event, or situation.
The installation of utility connections—such as electricity, water, gas, or internet—from the main line to a building.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb ⟦{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む→引き込む：05736_hikikomu⟧ (to draw in, to pull in). Sense 1 is used broadly for attracting people or pulling someone/something into a space or situation. Sense 2 is a technical term in construction and real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{込|こ}み: drawing in customers
- {引|ひ}き{込|こ}み⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: service connection installation work
- {引|ひ}き{込|こ}み⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: service line, lead-in wire
- {引|ひ}き{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: service entrance point
